response.content: {"findings":[{"location":"section","severity":"major","source_quote":"FEATURED ARTICLE","suggested_fix":"Use “UITGELIGTE ARTIKEL” or another standard Afrikaans equivalent of “FEATURED ARTICLE.”","translation_quote":"GEWILDE ARTIKEL"},{"location":"Paragraph 2","severity":"major","source_quote":"“complete trust or confidence in someone or something.”","suggested_fix":"Translate the full definition, for example: “volledige vertroue in of sekerheid oor iemand of iets.”","translation_quote":"“volledige vertroue in iemand of iets.”"},{"location":"Paragraph 6","severity":"major","source_quote":"“so that people are without excuse”","suggested_fix":"Translate the causal relation faithfully, e.g. “sodat mense geen verontskuldiging het nie.”","translation_quote":"“omdat dit verstaan word uit wat gemaak is, sodat mense geen verontskuldiging het nie”"},{"location":"Paragraph 8","severity":"major","source_quote":"“Yet, he went against all reasoning and said he needed more evidence.”","suggested_fix":"Replace “geïgnoreer” with wording meaning “went against,” such as “Tog het hy teen alle redenering in gegaan en gesê dat hy meer bewyse nodig het.”","translation_quote":"“Tog het hy alle redenering geïgnoreer en gesê dat hy meer bewyse nodig het.”"},{"location":"Paragraph 9","severity":"major","source_quote":"“They blindly cling to various theories such as: The Big Bang, Punctuated Equilibrium, and Descent with Modification.”","suggested_fix":"Translate the cited theory names as well as the sentence, for example: “Hulle klou blindelings vas aan verskeie teorieë soos die Oerknal, Punctuated Equilibrium (onderbroke ewewig) en afstamming met verandering.”","translation_quote":"“Hulle klou blindelings vas aan verskeie teorieë soos die Oerknal, Punctuated Equilibrium en Afstamming met Verandering.”"}],"passed":false,"score":87}
